overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: Runs a credit-card back office: CICS screens for sign-on, accounts, cards, transactions, bill payment, users and reports over VSAM masters.
Batch posts the daily transactions (POSTTRAN/CBTRN02C), computes monthly interest (INTCALC/CBACT04C) and prints statements (CREASTMT/CBSTM03A).
The VSAM files are shared with CICS: batch jobs close and reopen them in the region (CLOSEFIL/OPENFIL) around every update.

overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: CA 7 table that runs the batch cycle: close CICS files, purge expired authorizations (CBPAUP0J), post the day's transactions (POSTTRAN), reopen files.
Then refreshes reference files (TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, TCATBALF), prints the masters (READ*), creates statements (CREASTMT, TXT2PDF1) and the category-balance report (PRTCATBL).

overviews.name: DAILY-TransactionBackup
key_points: Daily Control-M folder that backs up the processed transaction file (TRANBKP) between a CICS file close and reopen.

overviews.name: WEEKLY-TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Weekly Control-M job MNTTRDB2 that maintains the DB2 transaction-type tables (module CDTRNTYP).

overviews.name: DisclosureGroupsRefresh
key_points: Control-M folder that reloads the disclosure group (interest rate) file (DISCGRP) between a CICS file close and reopen.

overviews.name: TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Control-M job TRANEXTR that extracts the DB2 transaction-type tables back to the files the core uses (module CDTRNTYP); it waits on MNTTRDB2's condition.

overviews.name: MONTHLY-InterestCalculation
key_points: Monthly Control-M folder: close CICS files, compute interest (INTCALC/CBACT04C), merge the interest transactions into the master (COMBTRAN), reopen files.

descriptions.name: CBACT01C
descriptions.description: Reads the account master file sequentially and writes each account to three output files in fixed, array and variable-length layouts.
key_points: Reads ACCTFILE to end of file and displays each record (1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT, 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD).
Writes OUTFILE, ARRYFILE and VBRCFILE (two variable-length record shapes) from each account.
Calls the assembler routine COBDATFT to reformat a date (CBACT01C.cbl:231).

descriptions.name: CBACT02C
descriptions.description: Reads the card master file sequentially and prints every card record.
key_points: Opens CARDFILE, reads to end of file and DISPLAYs each record.

descriptions.name: CBACT03C
descriptions.description: Reads the card-to-account cross-reference file sequentially and prints every record.
key_points: Opens XREFFILE, reads to end of file and DISPLAYs each record.

descriptions.name: CBACT04C
descriptions.description: Calculates monthly interest per account from the transaction category balances and writes interest transactions.
key_points: Reads TCATBALF and, per account, the XREF and ACCTFILE records; the rate comes from DISCGRP, falling back to group DEFAULT.
Monthly interest = TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE / 1200; each charge is written to TRANSACT and the account is rewritten.
1400-COMPUTE-FEES is a stub ('To be implemented'); the run date comes from the step PARM.

descriptions.name: CBCUS01C
descriptions.description: Reads the customer master file sequentially and prints every customer record.
key_points: Opens CUSTFILE, reads to end of file and DISPLAYs each record.

descriptions.name: CBEXPORT
descriptions.description: Runs the customer-data export: defines the export file and runs CBEXPORT over the VSAM masters.
key_points: STEP01 IDCAMS defines the export dataset; STEP02 runs CBEXPORT.

descriptions.name: CBIMPORT
descriptions.description: Runs the customer-data import: CBIMPORT splits the export file into normalized output files.
key_points: Single step STEP01 EXEC PGM=CBIMPORT.

descriptions.name: CBSTM03A
descriptions.description: Prints account statements from transaction data in plain-text and HTML formats.
key_points: Writes STMTFILE (text) and HTMLFILE (HTML) statements per card in the cross-reference.
Delegates all file I/O to the subroutine CBSTM03B.
Deliberately uses control-block addressing, ALTER/GO TO, COMP/COMP-3 and a 2-D table (header comment).

descriptions.name: CBSTM03B
descriptions.description: Subroutine that performs the file I/O for the statement program CBSTM03A.
key_points: Opens, reads and closes TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, CUSTFILE and ACCTFILE on request from the caller.

descriptions.name: CBTRN01C
descriptions.description: Reads the daily transaction file and verifies each card against the cross-reference and account files.
key_points: Reads DALYTRAN; for each record looks up XREFFILE by card number and ACCTFILE by account id.
Only DISPLAYs the result (account not found / card number); it writes no file.

descriptions.name: CBTRN02C
descriptions.description: Posts the daily transaction file: validates each transaction, writes it to the transaction master and updates balances.
key_points: Rejects with codes 100-103 (invalid card, account not found, overlimit, after account expiry) to DALYREJS.
Writes valid transactions to TRANFILE, rewrites the account and creates or updates the TCATBALF category balance.

descriptions.name: CBTRN03C
descriptions.description: Prints the transaction detail report for a date range with page, account and grand totals.
key_points: Reads the date range from DATEPARM and TRANFILE sequentially.
Enriches each line via CARDXREF, TRANTYPE and TRANCATG lookups and writes TRANREPT.

descriptions.name: COACTUPC
descriptions.description: CICS account update screen: shows an account with its customer and validates and applies edits.
key_points: Reads ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT and the CXACAIX account path; rewrites account and customer records after edit checks.
Returns to the calling program or main menu by XCTL (dynamic, COACTUPC.cbl:956).

descriptions.name: COACTVWC
descriptions.description: CICS account view screen: displays an account with its customer details.
key_points: Reads the card cross-reference by account path, then ACCTDAT and CUSTDAT.
Returns to the caller or main menu by XCTL (COACTVWC.cbl:349).

descriptions.name: COADM01C
descriptions.description: CICS admin menu for admin users: lists the admin options and transfers to the chosen program.
key_points: Options come from the COADM02Y table (6 active); the chosen program is XCTLed with the CardDemo COMMAREA.
Options include user list/add/update/delete and the DB2 transaction-type screens of module CDTRNTYP.

descriptions.name: COBIL00C
descriptions.description: CICS bill payment: pays an account's current balance in full and records the payment as a transaction.
key_points: Reads ACCTDAT and CXACAIX, writes a payment record to TRANSACT and rewrites the account balance.
Uses ASKTIME/FORMATTIME for the transaction timestamp.

descriptions.name: COBSWAIT
descriptions.description: Batch utility that waits for the number of centiseconds passed in the PARM.
key_points: Calls the assembler routine MVSWAIT with the PARM value (COBSWAIT.cbl:38).

descriptions.name: COCRDLIC
descriptions.description: CICS credit-card list: shows all cards for an admin, or only the cards of the account in the COMMAREA.
key_points: Browses CARDDAT; selecting a row transfers to card detail COCRDSLC or card update COCRDUPC.
PF3 returns to the main menu COMEN01C.

descriptions.name: COCRDSLC
descriptions.description: CICS card detail screen: shows one credit card selected by account and card number.
key_points: Reads CARDDAT by card number or through the account path CARDAIX.
Returns to the caller or main menu by XCTL (COCRDSLC.cbl:331).

descriptions.name: COCRDUPC
descriptions.description: CICS card update screen: edits a credit card's details and rewrites the card record.
key_points: Reads CARDDAT for update and REWRITEs it after validation.
Returns to the caller or main menu by XCTL (COCRDUPC.cbl:473).

descriptions.name: COMEN01C
descriptions.description: CICS main menu for regular users: lists the menu options and transfers to the chosen program.
key_points: Options come from the COMEN02Y table (11 active); admin-only options are refused for regular users.
Option COPAUS0C (pending authorizations, module CDAUTHFR) is only XCTLed after CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM succeeds.

descriptions.name: CORPT00C
descriptions.description: CICS report request: submits the transaction report batch job from online through an extra-partition TDQ.
key_points: Builds in-line JCL that runs PROC TRANREPT for the chosen date range (CORPT00C.cbl:94).
Writes the job to a TD queue (WRITEQ TD, CORPT00C.cbl:517) for the internal reader.

descriptions.name: COSGN00C
descriptions.description: CICS sign-on screen: validates user id and password against the user security file and routes by user type.
key_points: Reads USRSEC by user id and compares the password.
Admin users go to COADM01C, regular users to COMEN01C (COSGN00C.cbl:232-237).

descriptions.name: COTRN00C
descriptions.description: CICS transaction list: pages through the TRANSACT file and lets the user select one transaction.
key_points: Browses TRANSACT forwards and backwards (PF7/PF8), ten rows per page.
Selecting a row with S transfers to the transaction view COTRN01C; PF3 returns to COMEN01C.

descriptions.name: COTRN01C
descriptions.description: CICS transaction view: reads and displays one transaction from the TRANSACT file.
key_points: Reads TRANSACT by transaction id and shows its fields; PF3 returns to the caller.

descriptions.name: COTRN02C
descriptions.description: CICS add transaction: validates a new transaction against card and account and writes it to TRANSACT.
key_points: Resolves the account through CXACAIX or the card through CCXREF before writing.
Writes the new record to TRANSACT with the next transaction id.

descriptions.name: COUSR00C
descriptions.description: CICS user list: pages through the user security file and selects a user to update or delete.
key_points: Browses USRSEC; selection U goes to COUSR02C and D to COUSR03C.

descriptions.name: COUSR01C
descriptions.description: CICS add user: writes a new regular or admin user to the user security file.
key_points: Validates the entry fields and WRITEs the record to USRSEC.

descriptions.name: COUSR02C
descriptions.description: CICS update user: reads a user from the security file and rewrites the changed fields.
key_points: READ UPDATE on USRSEC followed by REWRITE (COUSR02C.cbl:322, :360).

descriptions.name: COUSR03C
descriptions.description: CICS delete user: reads a user from the security file and deletes it on confirmation.
key_points: READ on USRSEC followed by DELETE (COUSR03C.cbl:269, :307).

descriptions.name: CSUTLDTC
descriptions.description: Date-validation subroutine that calls the Language Environment CEEDAYS API and returns its feedback as a message.
key_points: Passes the date and its format to CEEDAYS and returns the Lilian date result and feedback code.

descriptions.name: ACCTFILE
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the account master VSAM KSDS: delete, define and load it from the flat account file.
key_points: Three IDCAMS steps: DELETE, DEFINE CLUSTER, REPRO.

descriptions.name: CARDFILE
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the card master VSAM file and its account alternate index, closing and reopening the CICS files around it.
key_points: SDSF step closes the CICS files; IDCAMS steps delete, define, load and build the AIX and path.

descriptions.name: CBADMCDJ
descriptions.description: Defines the CardDemo CICS resources (groups, programs, mapsets, transactions, files) with DFHCSDUP.
key_points: One DFHCSDUP step with in-stream DEFINE statements.

descriptions.name: CBEXPORT
descriptions.description: Runs the customer-data export: defines the export file and runs CBEXPORT over the VSAM masters.
key_points: STEP01 IDCAMS defines the export dataset; STEP02 runs CBEXPORT.

descriptions.name: CBIMPORT
descriptions.description: Runs the customer-data import: CBIMPORT splits the export file into normalized output files.
key_points: Single step STEP01 EXEC PGM=CBIMPORT.

descriptions.name: CLOSEFIL
descriptions.description: Closes the CardDemo files in the CICS region through an SDSF console command so batch can update them.
key_points: Single SDSF step issuing CEMT SET FILE CLOSE commands.

descriptions.name: COMBTRAN
descriptions.description: Sorts the current transaction file together with system-generated transactions and reloads the transaction master.
key_points: STEP05R SORT merges the inputs; STEP10 IDCAMS REPROs the result to the VSAM master.

descriptions.name: CREASTMT
descriptions.description: Creates a statement for every card in the cross-reference: sorts transactions, loads a work KSDS and runs CBSTM03A.
key_points: DELDEF01 and STEP020 IDCAMS manage the work cluster; STEP010 SORTs the transactions.
STEP040 runs CBSTM03A to write the text and HTML statements.

descriptions.name: CUSTFILE
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the customer master VSAM file with the CICS files closed and reopened around it.
key_points: SDSF close, IDCAMS delete/define/load, SDSF open.

descriptions.name: DALYREJS
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group base for the daily transaction reject file.
key_points: Single IDCAMS step.

descriptions.name: DEFCUST
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the customer VSAM cluster.
key_points: Two IDCAMS steps (both named STEP05).

descriptions.name: DEFGDGB
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group bases the CardDemo batch jobs need.
key_points: Single IDCAMS DEFINE GDG step.

descriptions.name: DEFGDGD
descriptions.description: Defines the TRANTYPE, TRANCATG and DISCGRP backup GDG bases and copies each flat file into a new (+1) generation.
key_points: Alternating IDCAMS DEFINE GENERATIONDATAGROUP and IEBGENER copy steps (STEP10-STEP60).

descriptions.name: DISCGRP
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the disclosure group (interest rate) VSAM file from its flat file.
key_points: Three IDCAMS steps: DELETE, DEFINE, REPRO.

descriptions.name: DUSRSECJ
descriptions.description: Creates and loads the user security VSAM file from in-stream user records.
key_points: IEFBR14 pre-delete, IEBGENER to a flat file, IDCAMS define and REPRO.

descriptions.name: ESDSRRDS
descriptions.description: Creates and loads ESDS and RRDS copies of the user security data, exercising other VSAM organisations.
key_points: IEFBR14 pre-delete, IEBGENER, then IDCAMS define/REPRO steps.

descriptions.name: FTPJCLS
descriptions.description: FTP job that receives a file onto the mainframe.
key_points: Single PGM=FTP step with in-stream FTP commands.

descriptions.name: INTCALC
descriptions.description: Runs the interest calculator CBACT04C over the transaction category balances.
key_points: Single step STEP15 PGM=CBACT04C with PARM='2022071800' (run date).

descriptions.name: INTRDRJ1
descriptions.description: Backs up AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST with IDCAMS REPRO, then submits member INTRDRJ2 to the internal reader.
key_points: IDCAMS REPRO IN -> OUT, then IEBGENER copies AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.JCL(INTRDRJ2) to SYSOUT=(A,INTRDR).

descriptions.name: INTRDRJ2
descriptions.description: Defines the physical VSAM files for the IMS database DEMODB and its index DEMODX.
key_points: Single IDCAMS step.

descriptions.name: OPENFIL
descriptions.description: Opens the CardDemo files in the CICS region through an SDSF console command after batch has finished.
key_points: Single SDSF step issuing CEMT SET FILE OPEN commands.

descriptions.name: POSTTRAN
descriptions.description: Posts the daily transaction file through CBTRN02C, updating the transaction master, accounts and category balances.
key_points: Single step STEP15 PGM=CBTRN02C; rejects go to a new DALYREJS generation.

descriptions.name: PRTCATBL
descriptions.description: Unloads the transaction category balance file and sorts it into a printable report.
key_points: IEFBR14 pre-delete, REPROC unload, SORT to the report.

descriptions.name: READACCT
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT01C to read the account master and write its fixed, array and variable-length extracts.
key_points: IEFBR14 pre-delete then STEP05 PGM=CBACT01C.

descriptions.name: READCARD
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT02C to print the card master file.
key_points: Single step STEP05 PGM=CBACT02C.

descriptions.name: READCUST
descriptions.description: Runs CBCUS01C to print the customer master file.
key_points: Single step STEP05 PGM=CBCUS01C.

descriptions.name: READXREF
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT03C to print the card cross-reference file.
key_points: Single step STEP05 PGM=CBACT03C.

descriptions.name: REPTFILE
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group base for the transaction report file.
key_points: Single IDCAMS step.

descriptions.name: TCATBALF
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the transaction category balance VSAM file from its flat file.
key_points: Three IDCAMS steps: DELETE, DEFINE, REPRO.

descriptions.name: TRANBKP
descriptions.description: Backs up the processed transaction file to a new generation and redefines the transaction VSAM master.
key_points: REPROC unload, then IDCAMS delete and define (STEP10 runs only if COND=(4,LT) allows).

descriptions.name: TRANCATG
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the transaction category type VSAM file from its flat file.
key_points: Three IDCAMS steps: DELETE, DEFINE, REPRO.

descriptions.name: TRANFILE
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the transaction master VSAM file and its processed-timestamp alternate index with the CICS files closed.
key_points: SDSF close, then IDCAMS delete/define/load/AIX steps.

descriptions.name: TRANIDX
descriptions.description: Creates the alternate index on processed timestamp for the transaction master and builds it.
key_points: IDCAMS define AIX, define PATH, BLDINDEX.

descriptions.name: TRANREPT
descriptions.description: Produces the transaction report: unloads and sorts the transactions for a date range and runs CBTRN03C.
key_points: REPROC unload, SORT by date filter, STEP10R PGM=CBTRN03C.

descriptions.name: TRANTYPE
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the transaction type VSAM file from its flat file.
key_points: Three IDCAMS steps: DELETE, DEFINE, REPRO.

descriptions.name: TXT2PDF1
descriptions.description: Converts a text report file to PDF with the TXT2PDF REXX exec under TSO batch.
key_points: IKJEFT1B step with SYSEXEC AWS.M2.LBD.TXT2PDF.EXEC.

descriptions.name: WAITSTEP
descriptions.description: Waits for the number of centiseconds in the PARM by running COBSWAIT.
key_points: Single step WAIT PGM=COBSWAIT.

descriptions.name: XREFFILE
descriptions.description: Rebuilds the card cross-reference VSAM file and its account alternate index.
key_points: IDCAMS delete, define, load, AIX define, path and BLDINDEX.

descriptions.name: REPROC
descriptions.description: PROC that runs IDCAMS REPRO to load or unload a VSAM file.
key_points: Single step PRC001 PGM=IDCAMS.

descriptions.name: TRANREPT
descriptions.description: PROC form of the transaction report: REPROC unload, SORT for the date range, then CBTRN03C.
key_points: STEP01R REPROC, STEP05R SORT, STEP10R PGM=CBTRN03C.
